headline: Bodhi Tree Multimedia schedules extraordinary general meeting for October 2026
hook: Upcoming vote for Bodhi Tree stakeholders
summary: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited has announced an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for October 28, 2026. The company formally notified the stock exchange regarding the upcoming shareholder gathering. Specific agenda details for the meeting were not disclosed in the filing. Retail investors holding shares in the micro-cap media firm should monitor subsequent disclosures for resolution details.
why_it_matters: Corporate decisions at the EGM may impact share value.

headline: Bodhi Tree Multimedia files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company completed the statutory filing with the stock exchange following the shareholder meeting. Routine corporate governance filings of this nature have minimal impact on stock price movement. Indian retail investors holding shares can note the procedural compliance completion.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no direct consequence for your portfolio.
